bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/core_ai.rs (InferenceSession: load, cached plan, typed call), inference.rs, ndarray.rs; springboard/ui/src/model_compile.rs, model_specialization.rs, model_assets.rs, work_stream.rs, ml_model.rs. Remote model clients: springboard/apps/daw/src/ai.rs, springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs. Text prediction is a word list: springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs
summary: Core AI runs specialized models on Apple silicon (CPU, GPU, Neural Engine) with model assets, cached specialization, inference functions and tensor types. BifrOSt runs small dense, relu and softmax models on the CPU through bifrost_app::core_ai (typed inference functions, cached plans); it has no GPU or large-model runtime and no compute stream that runs work. Its AI features call the Anthropic cloud API, and its predictive text is a trie with bigrams.

Gap: only dense, relu and softmax chains run (no GPU kernels, no importer for other formats); not checked on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs (prefix trie, bigram bonus, edit-distance-1 autocorrect)
features.note: Prediction runs on-device but uses frequency lists, not a neural model. The Assistant app (springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs) sends its requests to the cloud.
The error type belongs to Core AI's asset pipeline, which BifrOSt does not have.

gaps: The on-device runtime evaluates dense, relu and softmax chains on the CPU only (bifrost_app::core_ai); no GPU or large-model kernels, no importer for other model formats.
No compute stream API for apps, so GPU or CPU inference cannot be offloaded from an app.
No model cache or ahead-of-time compile step.
No inference-level profiling or tracing in the debug tools.
The AI features (daw/ai.rs, assistant model.rs) depend on the cloud API, not local inference.
